text: No, FIRMS did not record any thermal detections within the property during the period from 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-26. The assessment shows zero detections from all sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS), which covered the entire area every day. However, this does not rule out small, short-lived, or obscured fires, as FIRMS may miss certain types of thermal activity. The evidence only confirms the absence of detected anomalies during the specified time frame.
